integrity: Graph and homotopy computation are specified by complete deterministic standard-library programs. The signed Morse boundary and its unimodular minor, not mod-two homology alone, establish the homotopy type. No external audit has been carried out.
scientific_limitations: This proves only the cuboctahedral graph case of a wider planar matching-complex problem; it does not establish a theorem for all planar graphs. The independent mod-two computation is only a cross-check of the integral discrete-Morse proof. An equivalent unindexed calculation may exist.
title: The cuboctahedral matching complex is a wedge of \(57\) three-spheres
